scope: Targeted primary-source audit, not exhaustive priority clearance.

sources.title: Cluster-Robust Prediction-Powered Inference
sources.established: Cluster-robust PPI++ covariance and power tuning, including partially labelled clusters.
sources.difference: The new controls concern proportional finite minimizer events for specified losses. No new cluster standard error, partial-labelling method or generic local/global distinction is claimed.

sources.title: Storage of correlated patterns in a perceptron
sources.established: Correlated ordinary-pattern capacity and correlation mixtures.
sources.difference: The first matched-covariance cluster contrast also changes ordinary capacity, so it cannot alone establish a specifically compensated increment. The ordinary-boundary-matched screening and the stronger samplewise human-invariant radial construction address this alternative.

sources.title: The existence of maximum likelihood estimate in high-dimensional binary response generalized linear models
sources.established: Ordinary binary-response existence with elliptical covariates under the stated conditions.
sources.difference: The radial construction concerns a two-sample subtracted prediction loss and scales the full utility, including its fitted intercept. Ordinary row-scale invariance is explicitly an established control.

sources.title: Correlation and scale in mixed logit models
sources.established: Scale-related coefficient correlation and the identification limits of separating scale and taste heterogeneity.
sources.application: The extension specifies the positive precision exogenously and scales every coefficient. It does not infer an unknown scale from null choices or claim to disentangle taste and scale.

sources.title: Phase transitions for the existence of unregularized M-estimators in single index models
sources.difference: The finite-infimum condition remains outside the subtracted labelled losses. Failure of a cited assumption is not an originality certificate.
